title: Pump unreachable alarm
symptom: After connecting to a new Dash pod and while preparing the site and inserting the cannula, the user hears a 'Pump unreachable' alarm, even though they have intentionally ended the previous pod and are in the process of starting a new one. The alarm is alarming and unwanted during the pod change process.
evidence_quote: There is a setting that lets you enable or disable this alert. I am going to open a feature request suggesting a time parameter to be added to the setting if possible.
